title: Missing Type-5 Route — VRF11 redistribute removed on dc1-leaf1a
symptom: VRF VRF11 inter-subnet routing failing on dc1-leaf1a. No Type-5 routes originated. L2 within VRF11 works normally.
root_cause: redistribute connected removed from VRF VRF11 BGP config on dc1-leaf1a. Type-5 IP prefix routes are no longer originated.
fix_command:
router bgp 65101
vrf VRF11
redistribute connected route-map RM-CONN-2-BGP-VRFS
